This '''Ithorian''' had two hostile confrontations with Prince [[Coby]] at the [[Zallakesh]] spaceport.

==Biography==
In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> while riding his beast of burden through the streets of the Zallakesh spaceport, this Ithorian was accidentally dismounted from it due to a collision with Prince [[Coby]]. Taking offense at this, the hot-tempered alien drew his blaster and began threatening Coby in an alien language. Shortly thereafter, the individual attempted to shoot down Coby's [[Blackhawk Destroyer]] as the boy attempted to pilot the out of control craft through the skies above the spaceport. As he took aim at the spacecraft, the Ithorian was tackled by spacecraft merchant "Honest" [[Tobar]], causing his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to fire harmlessly into the sky.<ref name=":0">{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
While hand held blasters are rarely seen in the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO'']] series, with even [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] being depicted as carrying [[Force pike/Legends|Blaster staffs]],<ref>{{DroidsCite|Tail of the Roon Comets}}</ref> this Ithorian seems to be an exception to the rule.<ref name=":0" />

Unlike other members of his species, this Ithorian has a single mouth on the front of his [[Ommatophora|eyestalk]] as opposed to two on the sides of his neck.<ref name=":0" /> In the [[Star Wars|''Star Wars'']] [[Canon]] a similar species called [[Ottegan]],<ref name=":1">[[Lost Stars|''Lost Stars'']]</ref> which did featured a single mouth,<ref name=":2">''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]''</ref> made its first appearance in the novel [[Lost Stars|''Lost Stars'']].<ref name=":1" /> The species was depicted as a genetic offshoot of the [[Ithorian|Ithorians]].<ref name=":2" />
